JOUR479T: Building Newsroom-Wide Tools with Artificial Intelligence
bio: I pitched, designed and taught this one-credit course during the spring 2026 semester at UMD. This course served as a basic introduction to creating and automating data pipelines for journalism. We covered topics such as building APIs, database creation and maintenance, Slackbots and cron jobs. A big portion of this class was about introducing students to ways journalists can use artificial intelligence to do a lot of this work for them, especially when they might end up in a smaller newsroom with less technical resources or expertise.
